span.p:
UPDATE provider_subscriptions
SET ai_messages_used = 0,
ai_quota_reset_at = 1st of next month
WHERE ai_quota_reset_at ≤ NOW()

span.p:
SELECT TRIAL subscriptions
WHERE expires_at ≤ NOW() + 3 days
AND no TRIAL_EXPIRING_SOON notif in last 7 days
